decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed variation of the condition on the basis of the wording set out below will meet the objectives of the original condition and so complies with UDP policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.

Condition : 2 - REVISED CONDITION 2:

The phases of the development permitted on 16 December 1999 for erection of two storey Hindu temple building with two storey annexe and basement (Reference 01501/A/P2) shall be defined as follows:

1)	Ground Floor:  Foundation of ground floor main hall, including toilets; steel frame on foundation; construction of ground floor main hall, including toilets up to and including roof and services;

2)	 First floor, including pinnacles and domes; and 

3)	Administration block, both floors.

No development shall take place on any part of any of the individual phases as defined above until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of all elements of the external surfaces of that phase of the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details.
description: Variation of Condition 2 (materials) of planning permission reference 01501/A/P2 'erection of 2 storey Hindu Temple' to allow a three stage phasing of construction
